segments.text:
V. 51.
If any eat of this bread—That is, believe in me: He ſhall live for ever—In other Words, He that believeth to the End ſhall be ſaved. My fleſh which I will give you—This whole Diſcourſe concerning his Fleſh and Blood refers directly to his Paſſion, and but remotely, if at all to the LORD'S Supper.
